description: See which outside pricing engines (vendor adapters, such as Pricefx and Prisync) this deployment has switched on. Each one lists its function name, its vendor and whether it is ready; one that is not says whether the adapters are off or that adapter is not configured. Read only: it never shows a setting value. A ready adapter is priced through by naming its function when computing a price, never by automatic routing. Needs a Last Price credential with function read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.
name: list_vendor_adapters
